description: This file defines the interface and constants for Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP) support in Zephyr OS, including API structures, protocol types, states, options, and management functions.

methods.name: net_ppp_init
methods.description: Initializes the PPP L2 stack for a given network interface.

methods.name: ppp_mgmt_raise_carrier_on_event
methods.description: Raises a CARRIER_ON event indicating PPP connection.

methods.name: ppp_mgmt_raise_carrier_off_event
methods.description: Raises a CARRIER_OFF event indicating PPP disconnection.

methods.name: ppp_mgmt_raise_phase_running_event
methods.description: Raises a PHASE_RUNNING event when PPP reaches the running phase.

methods.name: ppp_mgmt_raise_phase_dead_event
methods.description: Raises a PHASE_DEAD event when PPP reaches the dead phase.

methods.name: net_ppp_ping
methods.description: Sends a PPP Echo-Request to the peer and waits for an Echo-Reply.

methods.name: net_ppp_context_get
methods.description: Retrieves PPP context information for a given interface index.
